title: The AI policy window is open. We need to act.
summary: Chris Lehane argues that stronger AI capabilities require stronger safety evidence, shared standards, and durable policy action while the policy window remains open.
body: Chris Lehane argues that stronger AI capabilities require stronger safety evidence, shared standards, and durable policy action while the policy window remains open.
summaryZh: OpenAI政策负责人Chris Lehane撰文指出，随着AI能力不断提升，行业需要建立更强的安全证据、共享标准以及持久的政策行动。
